title: Frontend
description: Browser errors and page loads reported by the site (OT-006). Reports are scrubbed in the browser and again on the server: pages are templates, never addresses; no query strings, fragments, emails or tokens. Members are named by user ID only, taken from the session. Page loads are the error rate's denominator, not traffic analytics (that is OT-005). Errors from other origins (extensions, third-party scripts) are logged but not counted in the error rate. Web Vitals are measured on the sampled share of page loads (PUBLIC_RUM_SAMPLE_RATE); LCP, FCP and TTFB per full load, INP and CLS per page visit. In-site navigations (total, fetch, swap and view transition) and panel times to interactive and ready are measured on the same sampled share.

list.name: release
list.label: Release
list.description: The release the before-and-after comparison is about.

list.name: release_start
list.label: Release first seen
list.description: Unix time of the selected release's first page load, within the 30 days metrics are kept (MetricsQL tfirst_over_time).

panels.title: Browser errors
Browser error rate by page and release
panels.description: Errors from the site's own scripts per page load, per page template and release (the BrowserErrorRateHigh alert's measure; it fires above 2% for 10 minutes with at least 1 page load a minute). Page loads carry no release, so right after a deploy each release's rate is measured against all of that page's loads.

targets.expr:
sum by (page, release) (increase(browser_error_total[$__rate_interval]))
  / on (page) group_left
sum by (page) (increase(browser_page_load_total[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Dropped browser reports
panels.description: Report events over the backend's recording budget (CLIENT_TELEMETRY_MAX_EVENTS_PER_SEC), counted but not recorded. Anything here means the errors above are undercounted.

targets.expr: sum(increase(browser_report_dropped_total[$__interval])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Browser error reports by page and release (logs)
panels.description: Occurrences of browser errors (each report's count), per page template and release. From the client_error log events.

targets.expr: event:="client_error" | stats by (page, release) sum(count) as errors

panels.title: Page loads by page
panels.description: Finished page loads and in-site navigations per page template: the error rate's denominator, not traffic analytics. Never sampled.

targets.expr: sum by (page) (increase(browser_page_load_total[$__interval]))

panels.title: Top errors (by fingerprint)
panels.description: The most frequent browser errors in the time range, grouped by fingerprint, with when each was first and last seen. Decode a stack from the example reports below with `just decode-stack <release>`.

targets.expr: _time:$__range event:="client_error" | stats by (error_fingerprint, kind) sum(count) as occurrences, count_uniq(page_load_id) as page_loads, min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen, uniq_values(page) as pages, uniq_values(release) as releases, uniq_values(error_message) limit 1 as message | sort by (occurrences desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Example reports
panels.description: Recent browser errors, newest first. client_trace_id (failed API calls only) opens the backend trace. user_id is present only for a signed-in Member, from the session.

targets.expr: event:="client_error" | sort by (_time desc) | limit 100 | fields _time, page, release, kind, error_message, count, error_fingerprint, client_trace_id, api_route, status, user_id, page_load_id, browser_family, device_class, source, stack

panels.title: Web Vitals
p75 Web Vitals by page, device class and sign-in (selected range)
panels.description: 75th percentile of each Web Vital over the selected time range (up to the 30 days metrics are kept). LCP, FCP and TTFB are per full page load; INP and CLS per page visit, including visits reached by in-site navigation. Green is good, orange needs improvement, red is poor (standard thresholds). Measured on the sampled share of page loads (PUBLIC_RUM_SAMPLE_RATE). The BrowserVitalPoor alert fires on a page whose p75 INP stays over 500 ms or LCP over 4 s for an hour, with at least 50 measurements an hour.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (page, device_class, authenticated, le) (increase(browser_web_vital_milliseconds_bucket{name="LCP"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (page, device_class, authenticated, le) (increase(browser_web_vital_milliseconds_bucket{name="FCP"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (page, device_class, authenticated, le) (increase(browser_web_vital_milliseconds_bucket{name="TTFB"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (page, device_class, authenticated, le) (increase(browser_web_vital_milliseconds_bucket{name="INP"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (page, device_class, authenticated, le) (increase(browser_web_vital_cls_bucket[$__range])))

panels.title: p75 INP by page and device class
panels.description: Interaction to Next Paint per page visit, 75th percentile over the last hour at each point (the BrowserVitalPoor window). Good up to 200 ms, poor over 500 ms.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (page, device_class, le) (increase(browser_web_vital_milliseconds_bucket{name="INP"}[1h])))

panels.title: p75 LCP by page and device class
panels.description: Largest Contentful Paint per full page load, 75th percentile over the last hour at each point. Good up to 2.5 s, poor over 4 s.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (page, device_class, le) (increase(browser_web_vital_milliseconds_bucket{name="LCP"}[1h])))

panels.title: p75 CLS by page and device class
panels.description: Cumulative Layout Shift per page visit (largest session window), 75th percentile over the last hour at each point. Good up to 0.1, poor over 0.25.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (page, device_class, le) (increase(browser_web_vital_cls_bucket[1h])))

panels.title: Rating shares by vital (selected range)
panels.description: Share of measurements rated good, needs improvement and poor, per Web Vital, over the selected range.

targets.expr:
sum by (name, rating) (increase(browser_web_vital_milliseconds_count[$__range]))
  / ignoring (rating) group_left
sum by (name) (increase(browser_web_vital_milliseconds_count[$__range]))
or
label_replace(
  sum by (rating) (increase(browser_web_vital_cls_count[$__range]))
    / ignoring (rating) group_left
  sum (increase(browser_web_vital_cls_count[$__range])),
  "name", "CLS", "", ""
)

panels.title: Release $release: p75 Web Vitals, 24 h before and after
panels.description: 75th percentile of each Web Vital over the 24 hours before the selected release's first page load and the 24 hours after it (the purple release annotations mark those times). The comparison is by time: right after a deploy, tabs still open on the previous release are mixed in for a while. LCP, FCP, TTFB and INP are in ms; CLS is a score. An empty After column means 24 hours haven't passed yet, or nothing was measured.

targets.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (name, le) (increase(browser_web_vital_milliseconds_bucket[24h] @ ${release_start})))
or
label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (le) (increase(browser_web_vital_cls_bucket[24h] @ ${release_start}))), "name", "CLS", "", "")

histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (name, le) (increase(browser_web_vital_milliseconds_bucket[24h] @ ${release_start} offset -24h)))
or
label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (le) (increase(browser_web_vital_cls_bucket[24h] @ ${release_start} offset -24h))), "name", "CLS", "", "")

panels.title: Browser error rate by release (selected range)
panels.description: Errors from the site's own scripts per page load of each release, over the selected range. Exact per release: both counts carry the release (page loads through browser.release_seen). Releases beyond the 5 a replica labels are grouped as other.

targets.expr:
(
  sum by (release) (increase(browser_error_total[$__range]))
  or sum by (release) (increase(browser_release_seen_total[$__range])) * 0
)
  /
sum by (release) (increase(browser_release_seen_total[$__range]))

panels.title: What the Web Vitals mean

options.content:
| Name | Stands for | What it measures | Measured | Good | Poor |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **LCP** | Largest Contentful Paint | When the largest image or text block on screen finished rendering: when the page looks loaded. | Each full page load | ≤ 2.5 s | > 4 s |
| **FCP** | First Contentful Paint | When the first text or image appeared: the first sign the page is loading. | Each full page load | ≤ 1.8 s | > 3 s |
| **TTFB** | Time to First Byte | From the start of the request until the first byte of the page arrived: server and network time. | Each full page load | ≤ 800 ms | > 1.8 s |
| **INP** | Interaction to Next Paint | How long the page took to visibly respond to a click, tap or key press, for the worst interaction of a visit (98th percentile past 50). | Each page visit, in-site navigations included | ≤ 200 ms | > 500 ms |
| **CLS** | Cumulative Layout Shift | How much content jumped around unexpectedly, as a score: the largest burst of shifts not caused by the user. No unit. | Each page visit, in-site navigations included | ≤ 0.1 | > 0.25 |

Values between good and poor are rated *needs improvement*.

- **Full page load:** the browser loaded a new document (opening the site, a reload, a link from outside).
- **Page visit:** the time spent on one page, whether it was reached by a full load or by in-site navigation (e.g. Home → Settings in the dashboard).
- **p75:** the 75th percentile, the value 3 in 4 measurements are at or under. It is the standard way to report Web Vitals: most visitors' experience, not the lucky or the unlucky few.
- **Device class:** desktop, tablet or mobile, from the browser's user agent.

Only a share of full page loads is measured (`PUBLIC_RUM_SAMPLE_RATE`). See [web.dev/vitals](https://web.dev/articles/vitals) for the full definitions.

panels.title: In-site navigation
p75 time to a usable page by destination, kind and device (selected range)
panels.description: 75th percentile, over the selected range, from the start of a navigation until the new page was usable and any view transition had finished. Hard is a full page load, timed from the start of the document; soft is an in-site navigation (ClientRouter), timed from the click or back/forward. Aborted navigations have no time and are left out. Measured on the sampled share of page loads (PUBLIC_RUM_SAMPLE_RATE).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (page, type, device_class, le) (increase(browser_navigation_duration_milliseconds_bucket[$__range])))
sum by (page, type, device_class) (increase(browser_navigation_duration_milliseconds_count[$__range]))

panels.title: p75 in-site navigation time by destination
panels.description: 75th percentile of in-site navigations (soft) over the last hour at each point: the BrowserNavigationSlow window. The alert fires on a dashboard page over 1 s for an hour, with at least 50 completed navigations an hour.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (page, le) (increase(browser_navigation_duration_milliseconds_bucket{type="soft"}[1h])))

panels.title: p75 phases of in-site navigations by destination (selected range)
panels.description: Where an in-site navigation's time goes: fetching the new page, swapping it into the document, and the view transition's animation (only when it ran). Each bar segment is that phase's own 75th percentile, so the stack is a guide, not the p75 total.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (page, le) (increase(browser_navigation_phase_duration_milliseconds_bucket{phase="fetch"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (page, le) (increase(browser_navigation_phase_duration_milliseconds_bucket{phase="swap"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (page, le) (increase(browser_navigation_phase_duration_milliseconds_bucket{phase="transition"}[$__range])))

panels.title: View transitions (selected range)
panels.description: Share of completed in-site navigations whose view transition ran, was skipped (superseded by another navigation, or reduced motion) or is unsupported by the browser (the page was swapped without one).

targets.expr:
sum by (view_transition) (increase(browser_navigation_duration_milliseconds_count{type="soft"}[$__range]))
  / scalar(sum(increase(browser_navigation_duration_milliseconds_count{type="soft"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Aborted in-site navigations by destination (selected range)
panels.description: Share of in-site navigations to each page that were interrupted by another navigation before the page was usable (counted for the page they were heading to). A high share can mean the page is slow to arrive.

targets.expr:
sum by (page) (increase(browser_navigation_total{outcome="aborted"}[$__range]))
  / sum by (page) (increase(browser_navigation_total[$__range]))

panels.title: Panel loading
p75 panel times by panel, navigation kind and device (selected range)
panels.description: For each panel and form, the 75th percentile time from the start of the navigation that showed it (the start of the page load for hard, the click for soft) until it was interactive (mounted) and until it was ready (showing its content, empty state or error state). The dashboard header stays across in-site navigation, so it is timed only on full loads. A panel the Member left before it was ready has no ready time.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (island, nav_type, device_class, le) (increase(browser_island_duration_milliseconds_bucket{stage="interactive"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (island, nav_type, device_class, le) (increase(browser_island_duration_milliseconds_bucket{stage="ready"}[$__range])))

panels.title: p75 time to ready by panel and navigation kind
panels.description: 75th percentile time to ready over the last hour at each point.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (island, nav_type, le) (increase(browser_island_duration_milliseconds_bucket{stage="ready"}[1h])))

list.name: Releases
list.expr:
count by (release) (sum by (release) (browser_release_seen_total{release!="other"}))
unless
count by (release) (sum by (release) (browser_release_seen_total{release!="other"} offset 1h))
